name: Flying
overview: Scripture uses the imagery of flying birds to illustrate God's protection, strength, and providence. The psalmist describes God as sovereign over the natural world, walking upon the wings of the wind and laying the foundations of the heavens (Psalms 104:3). Believers are likened to birds escaping snares, symbolizing deliverance through God's mercy (Psalms 124:7). Isaiah portrays the LORD as a defender who, like flying birds, preserves and delivers His people (Isaiah 31:5), while also promising renewed strength to those who wait on Him, enabling them to soar like eagles (Isaiah 40:31). This imagery highlights God's sustaining power and care for His people in their spiritual journey.
